nodes.name: DashboardView.module.css
nodes.summary: CSS module styling the main dashboard hero card, gain/loss badges, placeholder member-data grid, and allocation/holdings section tab toggles for DashboardView.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses CSS custom properties (design tokens) for spacing, color, radius, and motion, plus a fadeIn keyframe animation and responsive breakpoints at 768px and 600px.

nodes.name: DistributorComparisonModal.module.css
nodes.summary: CSS module styling the distributor comparison modal's scheme header, loading skeleton, error state, and comparison table with positive/negative highlighting.

nodes.name: FundDetailModal.module.css
nodes.summary: CSS module styling the fund detail modal's KPI grid, detail rows, and action footer, with gain/loss text coloring and a responsive single-column KPI layout under 600px.

nodes.name: NavigationShell.module.css
nodes.summary: CSS module styling the app's sticky top navigation shell: logo mark, nav links with active/disabled/coming-soon states, family/individual view toggle, member selector, and theme toggle button.
